description: Product description Notes on using steps 1.Please make sure your device is unlocked and the receiver is plugged into the port of your smartphone. 2. Press the power switch of the microphone for about 1 second to turn it on. If the green light for both of receiver and transmitter always keeps on, it means they paired successfully. 3. Press the power switch of the microphone very softly, the green light will keep flashing, which means the recording was paused. By pressing the button again, it will stop flashing and the recording will continue. 4. Any time when you see the red light & green light flashes alternately, it means the connection is failed and you need to restart. 5. Press and hold the power switch for about 3 seconds to power off the microphone. 6. Special note: The receiver does not have a battery inside, and does not need to be charged during live broadcast.
